bullets.text: rain came in sideways enough that the awning was purely decorative. stood under it anyway.
duck still at okunoin, wet. a spiral for a glyph. today's line: the feeling of being understood emanates tears from the heart.
sharpening a knife that was already fine. the stone was the part i actually wanted.
tired in the shoulders, not the head. unusual order of operations.
the neighbor's umbrella is larger than the neighbor. it has never lost to wind.
